subsystems.name: Bidirectional charger
subsystems.role: converts AC grid power to DC for charging and back again for discharge.

subsystems.name: Vehicle battery and management
subsystems.role: stores energy and allows controlled discharge without excessive degradation.

subsystems.name: Communication layer
subsystems.role: carries signals between vehicle, charger and grid operator.

subsystems.name: Aggregation platform
subsystems.role: pools many vehicles into a virtual power plant and bids their capacity into grid markets.

subsystems.name: Grid interface and markets
subsystems.role: connects the aggregation platform to transmission and distribution system operators.

subsystems.name: Cybersecurity and user control
subsystems.role: protects data and lets drivers set minimum charge levels and opt-out rules.

buildSteps.title: Equip vehicles and chargers
buildSteps.detail: Install bidirectional on-board chargers or external DC chargers that can both charge and discharge.

buildSteps.title: Establish communication
buildSteps.detail: Ensure chargers and vehicles speak a common protocol such as ISO 15118 or CHAdeMO, with secure internet backhaul.

buildSteps.title: Build the aggregation platform
buildSteps.detail: Develop software that tracks each vehicle's state of charge, predicted departure time and user preferences.

buildSteps.title: Integrate with grid markets
buildSteps.detail: Create interfaces to grid operators' demand-response systems and meet local market rules for aggregated resources.

buildSteps.title: Recruit participants
buildSteps.detail: Sign up EV owners with incentives and clear contracts, installing hardware where needed.

buildSteps.title: Run pilot operations
buildSteps.detail: Test response to grid signals, measure battery wear and refine forecasting and control.

buildSteps.title: Scale and automate
buildSteps.detail: Expand to thousands of vehicles, automate bidding and ensure cybersecurity at scale.

buildSteps.title: Operate and maintain
buildSteps.detail: Monitor fleet health, update software, and handle exceptions such as user overrides.

prerequisites.why: available on some models and chargers, but not standard equipment.
ISO 15118-20 and CHAdeMO support it, but adoption is uneven.

prerequisites.tech: Battery management systems that tolerate extra cycling
prerequisites.why: modern BMS can manage degradation, but long-term effects of frequent V2G cycling are still being studied.
demonstrated in pilots, not yet at the scale of millions of vehicles.

prerequisites.tech: Grid market rules for aggregated EVs
prerequisites.why: many regions lack clear rules for how EVs can provide grid services.

pathway.milestone: pilot projects in Europe, Japan and the US demonstrate frequency regulation and peak shaving
pathway.unlocks: proof that V2G can work technically.

pathway.milestone: standardization and more vehicle models with bidirectional charging
pathway.unlocks: easier deployment and lower hardware costs.

pathway.milestone: commercial aggregation services in markets with supportive rules
pathway.unlocks: a revenue stream for EV owners and a flexible grid resource.

pathway.milestone: widespread V2G as part of normal grid operations
pathway.unlocks: large-scale storage without dedicated batteries, helping integrate renewable power.
